sources.what: mid-stream errors: a top-level error {code, message, metadata.error_type} with a choice whose finish_reason is error; the stream ends after it; the error can be the first and only event
errors after the response is committed arrive as an SSE event, the status stays 200
zero completion insurance: a response with an error finish reason is not billed

note: the errors page's example: a rate limit as the first and only event (no [DONE]); nothing was generated, nothing is billed
